title: Retain selected tree nodes and their ancestors
prompt:
Repair solve(payload). Input is {"tree": node_or_null, "keep": [string_ids]}. Every node is exactly
{"id": unique_string, "children": [nodes]}. Return a new tree containing exactly the existing IDs
listed in keep and all their ancestors. A kept node does not automatically retain its descendants.
Preserve the original sibling order and the id/children shape. Return null if no existing node is
kept, including when tree is null. Duplicate or unknown IDs in keep have no additional effect.

Do not mutate the input. Use only Python's standard library.

Public examples:
- Input: `{"tree": {"id": "r", "children": [{"id": "a", "children": []}, {"id": "b", "children": []}]}, "keep": ["b"]}`; output: `{"id": "r", "children": [{"id": "b", "children": []}]}`.
- Input: `{"tree": {"id": "r", "children": []}, "keep": []}`; output: `null`.

files.public_tests.py:
# SPDX-License-Identifier: AGPL-3.0-only
import copy
import json
import unittest
from solution import solve

CASES = json.loads('[{"name": "leaf", "input": {"tree": {"id": "r", "children": [{"id": "a", "children": []}, {"id": "b", "children": []}]}, "keep": ["b"]}, "expected": {"id": "r", "children": [{"id": "b", "children": []}]}}, {"name": "none", "input": {"tree": {"id": "r", "children": []}, "keep": []}, "expected": null}]')

class PublicExamples(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_examples(self):
        for item in CASES:
            with self.subTest(name=item["name"]):
                value = copy.deepcopy(item["input"])
                self.assertEqual(solve(value), item["expected"])
                self.assertEqual(value, item["input"], "solve must not mutate its input")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
